Verify go version -m binary source; no shared daemon restart. Helper access is explicit assistance; discover actual control fields yourself. Archive frames before printing selected fields. Pipe JSON to python3 -c, not to a Python heredoc.

Huyang owns all source reads/searches/copies/edits/report creation. Shell only Git, builds/tests, program execution and transport/log parsing. Reports must be checkpointed via Huyang after setup and each goal under YOUR worker root: docs/friction/2026-09-13-language-expansion/raw/c.md, evidence under docs/friction/2026-09-13-language-expansion/raw/c-evidence/. Do not spend entire budget on one failed language-server startup: record it after bounded retries and continue independent goals.

Commit target changes in its nested repo, but do not add nested gitlink or push anything. Commit worker reports/evidence separately. Final include absolute target path, target baseline/result commits, worker report commit and raw artifacts, measured tests and unknowns. No user questions.
